title: 第二十三章 命之贵贱新书求追读求月票第二十四章 再见牵丝狼
slug: 从效法万妖开始成就真仙
lines: 俗话说，断人钱财如杀人父母。
棺材堵门。
便是不死不休的意思。
地上血污尚存，老人的独子和爱徒，全都魂断这条巷子内。
如今他已是孑然一身，瘦削身影透着凄然。
嗓音泛凉，只为讨个公道！
张仲平仿佛不再是鸿运武馆的馆主，而是被帮派屠戮满门，仅存最后一腔复仇之心的可怜老人。
在这种情况下，就算衙门的人来了，恐怕也不好轻易插手。
谁能阻止这样的一个老头替儿子报仇。
莫不是要为黑水帮站台？
张仲平已经孤注一掷，容不得半点差错，他甚至把那个年轻的紫蛟捕快都给算了进去！
喜鹊窝大门半掩。
只有恰巧在扫地的金桂呆立原地，被这位大武师逮了个正着。
她吓得双腿发软，原本想像别的姑娘那样，先退回屋内，让林爷来处理此事。
可当听见那句情真意切的“杀人偿命”以后。
金桂忽然回想起了那天张辞过来时，自己绝望嘶鸣哭嚎的狼狈模样。
她吞咽着干涩的喉咙，颤颤回头，有些不理解道：“既然你懂这个道理，为什么又要放任自己的独子，毫无理由的害死我们两条性命？”
金桂只是个再普通不过的窑姐。
面对着一位声名赫赫的大武师，能说出话来已实属不易。
所以她的嗓音很低，语气很软。
软到压根不像一句质问。
但这句话，却是让张仲平的脸皮迅速颤动起来。
一抹浓郁的暴怒迅速占据了他的眼眸。
这位老人难以置信的抬起头，像是受了莫大侮辱，连嗓音都尖锐了许多：
“你拿婊子的贱命，去和我儿相比？！”
话音间，张仲平身上散发的浑厚气息不自觉肆虐开来。
汹涌的压迫感让金桂脸色惨白，迅速理解了为何命分贵贱的原因。
旁边看热闹的人神情骤变，赶忙连连退开。
传闻大武师强悍，但唯有亲身体会一次，方才知道那些传闻还远不够贴切。
若自己是喜鹊窝那头狐狸，是万万不肯现身独面对方的。
这也太吓人了些。
啪啪。
突然响起的鼓掌声，替金桂回应了张仲平的问题。
“说得好。”
长衫青年从楼上踱步而下，感慨的拍着手。
content_en:
;;
As the saying goes, cutting off someone's money is like killing one's parents.
The coffin blocks the door.
It means never ending.
There is still blood on the ground, and the old man's only son and beloved disciple all died in this alley.
Now he was alone, his thin figure looking sad.
My voice is cold, just to seek justice!
Zhang Zhongping seems to be no longer the owner of Hongyun Martial Arts School, but a poor old man who has been slaughtered by gangs and has only the last heart of revenge.
In this case, even if people from the Yamen come, I am afraid it will not be easy to intervene.
Who can stop such an old man from avenging his son?
Could it be that he wants to stand up for the Blackwater Gang?
Zhang Zhongping had made a desperate move and could not tolerate any mistakes. He even included the young purple dragon catcher!
"..."
The door to the magpie's nest is ajar.
Only Jin Gui, who happened to be sweeping the floor, stood still and was caught by the great martial artist.
She was so frightened that her legs were weak. She originally wanted to do what other girls did, retreat into the house and let Mr. Lin handle the matter.
But when I heard the sincere sentence "Kill to pay for life".
Jin Gui suddenly recalled how miserable he looked in despair and howling when Zhang Ci came over that day.
She swallowed her dry throat, looked back tremblingly, and said with some confusion: "Since you understand this truth, why did you let your only son kill two of our lives for no reason?"
Jin Gui is just an ordinary kiln girl.
It is not easy to speak in front of a famous martial artist.
So her voice was low and her tone was soft.
It was so soft that it didn't even sound like a question.
But these words made Zhang Zhongping's face tremble quickly.
A strong rage quickly took over his eyes.
The old man raised his head in disbelief, as if he had been greatly insulted, and even his voice became much sharper:
"You compare the bitch's life with that of my son?!"
As he spoke, the rich aura emanating from Zhang Zhongping spread unknowingly.
The surging sense of oppression made Jin Gui's face turn pale, and he quickly understood the reason why fate was divided into high and low.
The expressions of the people watching the excitement changed suddenly and they quickly backed away.
It is said that the great martial artist is powerful, but only after experiencing it for himself can he realize that those rumors are far from accurate.
If he were the fox in the magpie's nest, he would never show up to face the other party alone.
This is too scary.
Snap.
A sudden burst of applause responded to Zhang Zhongping's question for Jin Gui.
"Well said."
The young man in a long gown walked downstairs and clapped his hands with emotion.
